Container.Name: deckcraft-web
Container.Overview: DeckCraft Web is a community-maintained Docker image that serves DeckCraft, a browser-based presentation and slide-deck editor. Create and edit presentations using the upstream WebAssembly application. The container only serves the static web interface through NGINX; slide editing and rendering take place in the browser, with no remote desktop or server-side presentation engine.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: DeckCraft Deck Craft Presentation Slide Deck Slideshow PowerPoint Browser WebAssembly WASM
Container.Requires: No special privileges, database, or persistent data volumes are required for the standard deployment. The web interface is served over HTTP on container port 8080. Presentation file handling depends on the upstream web application and browser capabilities. Use HTTPS through a reverse proxy for remote access where required by browser security restrictions.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access the DeckCraft Web interface. The container listens on port 8080.
